demos.name: BasicButtonGroup
demos.description: The buttons can be grouped by wrapping them with the ButtonGroup component.

demos.name: VariantButtonGroup
demos.description: All the standard button variants are supported.

demos.name: GroupSizesColors
demos.description: The size and color props can be used to control the appearance of the button group.

demos.name: GroupOrientation
demos.description: The button group can be displayed vertically using the orientation prop.

demos.name: SplitButton
demos.description: ButtonGroup can also be used to create a split button.

demos.name: DisableElevation
demos.description: You can remove the elevation with the disableElevation prop.

demos.name: LoadingButtonGroup
demos.description: Use the loading prop from Button to set buttons in a loading state and disable interactions.
